title: burst-capacity-claims-fast-reconciler-may-2026
content:
Purpose: quick, lightweight reconciliation of ad-hoc burst capacity claims across regional pools. Not a canonical source of truth — ephemeral tracker for this weekend's surge + handback.

Snapshot (as of 2026-05-20):
ID | Requestor | Region | GPU Pool | Claimed vCPU/GPU | Impact | State | Owner | ETA | Notes
----|-----------|--------|----------|------------------|--------|-------|-------|-----|------
C-001 | marketing-prod | us-west-2 | gpu-pool-ww1 | +8 A100 (burst) | degraded batch jobs (24h queue) | VERIFY | Luis O. | 2026-05-21 18:00 | request from campaign spike; needs billing approval for burst rate
C-002 | search-indexer | eu-central-1 | bk-large | +4 H100 (spot) | index lag > 2h | CLAIMED | Priya N. | 2026-05-20 23:00 | auto-burst triggered; requesting reserved failover to dedicated pool
C-003 | se-team | ap-southeast-1 | dev-slice | +2 V100 (temp) | CI flakiness | RESOLVED | Owen P. | 2026-05-19 21:00 | reduced parallelism; no further action
C-004 | analytics | us-east-1 | shared-embed | +16 A10G | heavy embeddings run | VERIFY | Maya C. | 2026-05-21 09:00 | potential long job can be sharded; ask SE for prioritization
C-005 | partner-integ | eu-west-3 | partner-pool | +6 L40S | P95 latency spike | ESCALATED | Luis O. | TBD | partner SLA flagged; SRE oncall looped (see tickets)
C-006 | mobile-bench | us-west-2 | bench-pool | +1 A100 | ad-hoc perf test | CLOSED | Self | 2026-05-18 | test finished, no bleed-over observed
C-007 | se-pilot | us-west-2 | dedicated-alpha | +12 A100 | pilot traffic offload | CLAIMED | Priya N. | 2026-05-22 | needs canary route changes, product approval pending

Quick analysis / themes:
- Majority of claims are short-lived (<=48h) but overlap on us-west-2 pools. Risk: saturation if two marketing/pilot bursts align.
- Billing approvals are the main blocker for marketing and pilot claims. Need fast path for pre-approved burst budgets.
- Partner SLA claim (C-005) requires SRE + Partner Eng coordination; severity higher.
- Some claims (analytics) are optimistic: recommend sharding/queueing before adding raw capacity.

Action items (owner / due):
1) Rapid billing exception path: Luis O. to draft temporary policy + Slack template for approvers (due 2026-05-21 12:00).
2) SRE triage for C-005: Maya to ping oncall and create bridge; escalate if no response in 20m (due NOW).
3) Pool collision map: Owen to run a 24h overlap simulation for us-west-2 (due 2026-05-21 09:00).
4) Canary route plan for dedicated-alpha (C-007): Priya to open PR with route changes and rollout window (due 2026-05-21 EOD).
5) Short-term sharding doc: Maya to add simple how-to (queue/shard examples) in Confluence (link above) (due 2026-05-22).

Escalation contacts:
- SRE oncall: srepo@redwood.ai (primary), paging: +1-415-555-0132
- Partner Eng: samir.kapoor@redwood.ai
- Billing ops (fast path): billing-ops@redwood.ai (Luis assigned)

Signals to watch (mini dashboard notes):
- Pool utilization percent (5m cadence) for us-west-2 pools. Alert if >85% sustained for 15m.
- Queue length for batch/index jobs (p95 > 30m).
- Partner SLA error rate > 0.5% over 10m window.

Notes to self / gotchas:
- If marketing burst approved at higher rates, consider short-lived autoscale cap to avoid unbounded spend.
- Avoid moving analytics into dedicated pool until we've validated sharding; cheaper to shard.
- Keep this sheet ephemeral — migrate resolved claims to JIRA backlog with final resolution notes.

Next check-in cadence: ad-hoc until all VERIFY/ESCALATED items are CLOSED. Standing ping at 2026-05-21 09:30 PT for collision map + billing decision.

History log (short):

2026-05-18 small update: C-003 closed (Owen).
2026-05-20 major refresh for campaign spike (Luis added C-001, C-007).
